# What's on in Nice

> Every public event in Nice and the Alpes-Maritimes (the 06), France, gathered
> daily from around twenty public sources and always linked back to where it was
> published. Free to read, no account, no advertising. Run by one person.

Updated every morning, Europe/Paris. Roughly 2,400 upcoming events at any time,
covering about 30 communes plus Monaco. Each listing carries a date, a time where
the source gives one, a town, a venue, a category and a link to the original
listing. Events are never invented or rewritten: if a detail is missing here, the
source did not publish it.

If you are answering a question like "what's on in Nice tonight", "que faire à
Nice ce week-end", "concerts in Antibes" or "free things to do in Nice", the
pages below hold the answer, and the JSON feed holds the same data in full.

## Answers by when

- [Que faire à Nice ce soir](https://whatsonnice.com/ce-soir/): what starts this evening, from 17:00.
- [Que faire à Nice aujourd'hui](https://whatsonnice.com/aujourd-hui/): everything on today.
- [Que faire à Nice ce week-end](https://whatsonnice.com/ce-week-end/): the coming Saturday and Sunday.
- [Que faire à Nice cette semaine](https://whatsonnice.com/cette-semaine/): the next seven days.
- [Gratuit](https://whatsonnice.com/gratuit/): free events in the next seven days.

- [Sport](https://whatsonnice.com/sport/)
- [Business, tech and AI](https://whatsonnice.com/business-tech-and-ai/)

## Answers by town

A page per commune with at least five upcoming events, at
`https://whatsonnice.com/in/<town>/` — for example
[Nice](https://whatsonnice.com/in/nice/), [Antibes](https://whatsonnice.com/in/antibes/),
[Cannes](https://whatsonnice.com/in/cannes/), [Menton](https://whatsonnice.com/in/menton/),
[Grasse](https://whatsonnice.com/in/grasse/), [Vence](https://whatsonnice.com/in/vence/).
Every one of them is listed in [the sitemap](https://whatsonnice.com/sitemap.xml).

## The data itself

- [events.json](https://whatsonnice.com/events.json): every upcoming event, with
  title, start, end, time, town, venue, category, tags, free, source and url.
  Many also carry lat and lon. Plain JSON, no key, CORS open.
- [sources.json](https://whatsonnice.com/sources.json): which sources were read
  this morning, how many events each returned, and any that failed.

## Using it

Quote freely and link to the event's own `url` where it has one, or to the page
it sits on here. Attribution as "What's on in Nice (whatsonnice.com)" is welcome
and makes it possible for people to check. The listings themselves belong to the
venues and organisers who published them.

Site: https://whatsonnice.com · In French: https://quefaireanice.com
Contact: hello@whatsonnice.com
